rules.behavior: All project modifications must run Change Compatibility Guard against live authoritative HEAD and retire conflicting legacy paths before verification.
acceptance: Retire old conflicting paths and test them negatively
Keep single owner of each responsibility

rules.behavior: A new modification request never authorizes the initial write until a pre-change report has been approved, while an approved scope does not require repeat approvals.
Only one coordinator writes any protected ref/resource, while independent isolated lanes can work concurrently.
acceptance: No overlapping writes to same ref

rules.behavior: Project domain behavior remains owned by the project engine; central MotorLab governs safe orchestration but never replaces the native engine.
acceptance: A satellite module cannot edit app runtime by fanout alone

rules.behavior: Use current verified pinned CORE and local satellite; adopt new release only at safe re-entry boundary with LAST_GOOD fallback.
